verses.original: בֶּן־ שָׁנָ֖ה שָׁא֣וּל בְּמָלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׁתֵּ֣י שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ben- šā·nāh šā·’ūl bə·mā·lə·ḵōw ū·šə·tê šā·nîm mā·laḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Saul was thirty years old when he became king and he reigned over Israel forty-two years
verses.literalPt: SAUL reinou um ano; e no segundo ano do seu reinado sobre Israel,

verses.original: וַיִּבְחַר־ ל֨וֹ שָׁא֜וּל שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֮ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיִּהְי֨וּ עִם־ שָׁא֜וּל אַלְפַּ֗יִם בְּמִכְמָשׂ֙ וּבְהַ֣ר בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל וְאֶ֗לֶף הָיוּ֙ עִם־ י֣וֹנָתָ֔ן בְּגִבְעַ֖ת בִּנְיָמִ֑ין וְיֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם שִׁלַּ֖ח אִ֥ישׁ לְאֹהָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·ḥar- lōw šā·’ūl šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm mî·yiś·rā·’êl way·yih·yū ‘im- šā·’ūl ’al·pa·yim bə·miḵ·māś ū·ḇə·har bêṯ- ’êl wə·’e·lep̄ hā·yū ‘im- yō·w·nā·ṯān bə·ḡiḇ·‘aṯ bin·yā·mîn wə·ye·ṯer hā·‘ām šil·laḥ ’îš lə·’ō·hā·lāw
verses.literal: He chose for himself three thousand men of Israel Two thousand were with Saul at Michmash and in the hill country of Bethel and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin And the rest of the troops he sent away each to his own home
verses.literalPt: Saul escolheu para si três mil homens de Israel; e estavam com Saul dois mil em Micmás e na montanha de Betel, e mil estavam com Jônatas em Gibeá de Benjamim; e o resto do povo despediu, cada um para sua casa.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ יוֹנָתָ֗ן אֵ֣ת נְצִ֤יב פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּגֶ֔בַע וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֖וּ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וְשָׁאוּל֩ תָּקַ֨ע בַּשּׁוֹפָ֤ר בְּכָל־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יִשְׁמְע֖וּ הָעִבְרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ yō·w·nā·ṯān ’êṯ nə·ṣîḇ pə·liš·tîm ’ă·šer bə·ḡe·ḇa‘ way·yiš·mə·‘ū pə·liš·tîm wə·šā·’ūl tā·qa‘ baš·šō·w·p̄ār bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ lê·mōr yiš·mə·‘ū hā·‘iḇ·rîm
verses.literal: Then Jonathan attacked the Philistine outpost at Geba and the Philistines heard about it So Saul blew the ram’s horn throughout the land saying Let the Hebrews hear
verses.literalPt: E Jônatas feriu a guarnição dos filisteus, que estava em Gibeá, o que os filisteus ouviram; pelo que Saul tocou a trombeta por toda a terra, dizendo: Ouçam os hebreus.

verses.original: וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֞ל שָׁמְע֣וּ לֵאמֹ֗ר הִכָּ֤ה שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת־ נְצִ֣יב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְגַם־ נִבְאַשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיִּצָּעֲק֥וּ הָעָ֛ם אַחֲרֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל הַגִּלְגָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl šā·mə·‘ū lê·mōr hik·kāh šā·’ūl ’eṯ- nə·ṣîḇ pə·liš·tîm wə·ḡam- niḇ·’aš yiś·rā·’êl bap·pə·liš·tîm way·yiṣ·ṣā·‘ă·qū hā·‘ām ’a·ḥă·rê šā·’ūl hag·gil·gāl
verses.literal: And all Israel heard the news Saul has attacked an outpost of the Philistines and now Israel has become a stench to the Philistines Then the people . . . were summoned to join Saul at Gilgal
verses.literalPt: Então todo o Israel ouviu dizer: Saul feriu a guarnição dos filisteus, e também Israel se fez abominável aos filisteus. Então o povo foi convocado para junto de Saul em Gilgal.

verses.original: וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֞ים נֶאֶסְפ֣וּ׀ לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים אֶ֤לֶף רֶ֙כֶב֙ וְשֵׁ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ פָּרָשִׁ֔ים וְעָ֕ם כַּח֛וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ שְׂפַֽת־ הַיָּ֖ם לָרֹ֑ב וַֽיַּעֲלוּ֙ וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ בְמִכְמָ֔שׂ קִדְמַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm ne·’es·p̄ū lə·hil·lā·ḥêm ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl šə·lō·šîm ’e·lep̄ re·ḵeḇ wə·šê·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm pā·rā·šîm wə·‘ām ka·ḥō·wl ’ă·šer ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ- hay·yām lā·rōḇ way·ya·‘ă·lū way·ya·ḥă·nū ḇə·miḵ·māś qiḏ·maṯ bêṯ ’ā·wen
verses.literal: Now the Philistines assembled to fight against Israel with three thousand chariots six thousand horsemen and troops as numerous as the sand on the seashore . . . They went up and camped at Michmash east of Beth-aven
verses.literalPt: E os filisteus se ajuntaram para pelejar contra Israel, trinta mil carros, e seis mil cavaleiros, e povo em multidão como a areia que está à beira do mar; e subiram, e se acamparam em Micmás, ao oriente de Bete-Áven.

verses.original: וְאִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל רָאוּ֙ כִּ֣י צַר־ ל֔וֹ כִּ֥י נִגַּ֖שׂ הָעָ֑ם וַיִּֽתְחַבְּא֣וּ הָעָ֗ם בַּמְּעָר֤וֹת וּבַֽחֲוָחִים֙ וּבַסְּלָעִ֔ים וּבַצְּרִחִ֖ים וּבַבֹּרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš yiś·rā·’êl rā·’ū kî ṣar- lōw kî nig·gaś hā·‘ām way·yiṯ·ḥab·bə·’ū hā·‘ām bam·mə·‘ā·rō·wṯ ū·ḇa·ḥă·wā·ḥîm ū·ḇas·sə·lā·‘îm ū·ḇaṣ·ṣə·ri·ḥîm ū·ḇab·bō·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: Seeing that they were in danger because their troops were hard-pressed the men of Israel hid in caves and thickets among the rocks and in cellars and cisterns
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, os homens de Israel que estavam em apuros (porque o povo estava angustiado), o povo se escondeu pelas cavernas, e pelos espinhais, e pelos penhascos, e pelas fortificações, e pelas covas.

verses.original: וְעִבְרִ֗ים עָֽבְרוּ֙ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶ֥רֶץ גָּ֖ד וְגִלְעָ֑ד וְשָׁאוּל֙ עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ בַגִּלְגָּ֔ל וְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם חָרְד֥וּ אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘iḇ·rîm ‘ā·ḇə·rū ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên ’e·reṣ gāḏ wə·ḡil·‘āḏ wə·šā·’ūl ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū ḇag·gil·gāl wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ḥā·rə·ḏū ’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: Some Hebrews even crossed the Jordan into the land of Gad and Gilead Saul, however remained at Gilgal and all his troops were quaking in fear . . .
verses.literalPt: E alguns dos hebreus passaram o Jordão para a terra de Gade e Gileade; e, estando Saul ainda em Gilgal, todo o povo ia atrás dele tremendo.

verses.original: וַיִּיחֶל שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים לַמּוֹעֵד֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וְלֹא־ בָ֥א שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הַגִּלְגָּ֑ל וַיָּ֥פֶץ הָעָ֖ם מֵעָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yī·ḥɛl šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm lam·mō·w·‘êḏ ’ă·šer šə·mū·’êl wə·lō- ḇā šə·mū·’êl hag·gil·gāl way·yā·p̄eṣ hā·‘ām mê·‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: And Saul waited seven days for the time appointed by Samuel but Samuel did not come to Gilgal and the troops began to desert Saul
verses.literalPt: E esperou Saul sete dias, até ao tempo que Samuel determinara; não vindo, porém, Samuel a Gilgal, o povo se dispersava dele.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל הַגִּ֣שׁוּ אֵלַ֔י הָעֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַיַּ֖עַל הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl hag·gi·šū ’ê·lay hā·‘ō·lāh wə·haš·šə·lā·mîm way·ya·‘al hā·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: So he said Bring me . . . the burnt offering and the peace offerings And he offered up the burnt offering
verses.literalPt: Então disse Saul: Trazei-me aqui um holocausto, e ofertas pacíficas. E ofereceu o holocausto.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּכַלֹּתוֹ֙ לְהַעֲל֣וֹת הָעֹלָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל בָּ֑א וַיֵּצֵ֥א שָׁא֛וּל לִקְרָאת֖וֹ לְבָרֲכֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḵal·lō·ṯōw lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ hā·‘ō·lāh wə·hin·nêh šə·mū·’êl bā way·yê·ṣê šā·’ūl liq·rā·ṯōw lə·ḇā·ră·ḵōw
verses.literal: Just as he finished offering the burnt offering . . . Samuel arrived and Saul went out to greet him
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, acabando ele de oferecer o holocausto, eis que Samuel chegou; e Saul lhe saiu ao encontro, para o saudar.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֡וּל כִּֽי־ רָאִיתִי֩ כִֽי־ נָפַ֨ץ הָעָ֜ם מֵעָלַ֗י וְאַתָּה֙ לֹא־ בָ֙אתָ֙ לְמוֹעֵ֣ד הַיָּמִ֔ים וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים נֶאֱסָפִ֥ים מִכְמָֽשׂ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl meh ‘ā·śî·ṯā way·yō·mer šā·’ūl kî- rā·’î·ṯî ḵî- nā·p̄aṣ hā·‘ām mê·‘ā·lay wə·’at·tāh lō- ḇā·ṯā lə·mō·w·‘êḏ hay·yā·mîm ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm ne·’ĕ·sā·p̄îm miḵ·māś
verses.literal: What have you done Samuel asked And Saul replied When I saw that the troops were deserting me and that you did not come at the appointed time and the Philistines were gathering at Michmash
verses.literalPt: Então disse Samuel: Que fizeste? Disse Saul: Porquanto via que o povo se espalhava de mim, e tu não vinhas nos dias aprazados, e os filisteus já se tinham ajuntado em Micmás,

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר עַ֠תָּה יֵרְד֨וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֤ים אֵלַי֙ הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל וּפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א חִלִּ֑יתִי וָֽאֶתְאַפַּ֔ק וָאַעֲלֶ֖ה הָעֹלָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ‘at·tāh yê·rə·ḏū p̄ə·liš·tîm ’ê·lay hag·gil·gāl ū·p̄ə·nê Yah·weh lō ḥil·lî·ṯî wā·’eṯ·’ap·paq wā·’a·‘ă·leh hā·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: I thought Now the Philistines will descend upon me at Gilgal and I have not sought the favor of the LORD So I felt compelled to offer the burnt offering
verses.literalPt: Eu disse: Agora descerão os filisteus sobre mim a Gilgal, e ainda à face do SENHOR não orei; e constrangi-me, e ofereci holocausto.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל אֶל־ שָׁא֖וּל נִסְכָּ֑לְתָּ לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗רְתָּ אֶת־ מִצְוַ֞ת יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ךְ כִּ֣י עַתָּ֗ה הֵכִ֨ין יְהוָ֧ה אֶת־ מַֽמְלַכְתְּךָ֛ אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ’el- šā·’ūl nis·kā·lə·tā lō šā·mar·tā ’eṯ- miṣ·waṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāḵ kî ‘at·tāh hê·ḵîn Yah·weh ’eṯ- mam·laḵ·tə·ḵā ’el- yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: You have acted foolishly Samuel declared - You have not kept the command that the LORD your God gave you if you had the LORD would have established your kingdom over Israel for all time
verses.literalPt: Então disse Samuel a Saul: Procedeste nesciamente, e não guardaste o mandamento que o SENHOR teu Deus te ordenou; porque agora o SENHOR teria confirmado o teu reino sobre Israel para sempre;

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה מַמְלַכְתְּךָ֣ לֹא־ תָק֑וּם בִּקֵּשׁ֩ יְהוָ֨ה ל֜וֹ אִ֣ישׁ כִּלְבָב֗וֹ וַיְצַוֵּ֨הוּ יְהוָ֤ה לְנָגִיד֙ עַל־ עַמּ֔וֹ כִּ֚י לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔רְתָּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶֽׁר־ צִוְּךָ֖ יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh mam·laḵ·tə·ḵā lō- ṯā·qūm biq·qêš Yah·weh lōw ’îš kil·ḇā·ḇōw way·ṣaw·wê·hū Yah·weh lə·nā·ḡîḏ ‘al- ‘am·mōw kî lō šā·mar·tā ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wə·ḵā Yah·weh
verses.literal: But now your kingdom will not endure the LORD has sought a man after His own heart and appointed him . . . ruler over His people because you have not kept - the command of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porém agora não subsistirá o teu reino; já tem buscado o SENHOR para si um homem segundo o seu coração, e já lhe tem ordenado o SENHOR, que seja capitão sobre o seu povo, porquanto não guardaste o que o SENHOR te ordenou.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל וַיַּ֛עַל מִן־ הַגִּלְגָּ֖ל גִּבְעַ֣ת בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וַיִּפְקֹ֣ד שָׁא֗וּל אֶת־ הָעָם֙ הַנִּמְצְאִ֣ים עִמּ֔וֹ כְּשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām šə·mū·’êl way·ya·‘al min- hag·gil·gāl giḇ·‘aṯ bin·yā·min way·yip̄·qōḏ šā·’ūl ’eṯ- hā·‘ām han·nim·ṣə·’îm ‘im·mōw kə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ ’îš
verses.literal: Then Samuel set out from Gilgal and went up to Gibeah in Benjamin And Saul numbered the troops . . . who were with him about six hundred men
verses.literalPt: Então se levantou Samuel, e subiu de Gilgal a Gibeá de Benjamim; e Saul contou o povo que se achava com ele, uns seiscentos homens.

verses.original: וְשָׁא֞וּל וְיוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנ֗וֹ וְהָעָם֙ הַנִּמְצָ֣א עִמָּ֔ם יֹשְׁבִ֖ים בְּגֶ֣בַע בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים חָנ֥וּ בְמִכְמָֽשׂ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·’ūl wə·yō·w·nā·ṯān bə·nōw wə·hā·‘ām han·nim·ṣā ‘im·mām yō·šə·ḇîm bə·ḡe·ḇa‘ bin·yā·min ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm ḥā·nū ḇə·miḵ·māś
verses.literal: Now Saul and Jonathan his son and the troops . . . with them were staying in Geba of Benjamin while the Philistines camped at Michmash
verses.literalPt: E Saul e Jônatas, seu filho, e o povo que se achou com eles, ficaram em Gibeá de Benjamim; porém os filisteus se acamparam em Micmás.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֧א הַמַּשְׁחִ֛ית מִמַּחֲנֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁ֑ים הָרֹ֨אשׁ אֶחָ֥ד יִפְנֶ֛ה אֶל־ דֶּ֥רֶךְ עָפְרָ֖ה אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ שׁוּעָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ham·maš·ḥîṯ mim·ma·ḥă·nêh p̄ə·liš·tîm šə·lō·šāh rā·šîm hā·rōš ’e·ḥāḏ yip̄·neh ’el- de·reḵ ‘ā·p̄ə·rāh ’el- ’e·reṣ šū·‘āl
verses.literal: And raiders went out of the Philistine camp in three divisions One headed toward Ophrah - in the land of Shual
verses.literalPt: E os saqueadores saíram do campo dos filisteus em três companhias; uma das companhias foi pelo caminho de Ofra à terra de Sual.

verses.original: וְהָרֹ֤אשׁ אֶחָד֙ יִפְנֶ֔ה דֶּ֖רֶךְ בֵּ֣ית חֹר֑וֹן וְהָרֹ֨אשׁ אֶחָ֤ד יִפְנֶה֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַגְּב֔וּל הַנִּשְׁקָ֛ף עַל־ גֵּ֥י הַצְּבֹעִ֖ים הַמִּדְבָּֽרָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·rōš ’e·ḥāḏ yip̄·neh de·reḵ bêṯ ḥō·rō·wn wə·hā·rōš ’e·ḥāḏ yip̄·neh de·reḵ hag·gə·ḇūl han·niš·qāp̄ ‘al- gê haṣ·ṣə·ḇō·‘îm ham·miḏ·bā·rāh
verses.literal: another - toward Beth-horon and the third . . . down the border road overlooking . . . the Valley of Zeboim facing the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Outra companhia seguiu pelo caminho de Bete-Horom, e a outra companhia foi pelo caminho do termo que dá para o vale Zeboim na direção do deserto.

verses.original: וְחָרָשׁ֙ לֹ֣א יִמָּצֵ֔א בְּכֹ֖ל אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּֽי־ אָמַר פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים פֶּ֚ן יַעֲשׂ֣וּ הָעִבְרִ֔ים חֶ֖רֶב א֥וֹ חֲנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·rāš lō yim·mā·ṣê bə·ḵōl ’e·reṣ yiś·rā·’êl kî- ʾå̄·mar p̄ə·liš·tîm pen ya·‘ă·śū hā·‘iḇ·rîm ḥe·reḇ ’ōw ḥă·nîṯ
verses.literal: And no blacksmith could be found in all the land of Israel because the Philistines had said The Hebrews must not be allowed to make swords or spears
verses.literalPt: E em toda a terra de Israel nem um ferreiro se achava, porque os filisteus tinham dito: Para que os hebreus não façam espada nem lança.

verses.original: וַיֵּרְד֥וּ כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים לִ֠לְטוֹשׁ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ מַחֲרַשְׁתּ֤וֹ וְאֶת־ אֵתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־ קַרְדֻּמּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֖ת מַחֲרֵשָׁתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rə·ḏū ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl hap·pə·liš·tîm lil·ṭō·wōš ’îš ’eṯ- ma·ḥă·raš·tōw wə·’eṯ- ’ê·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- qar·dum·mōw wə·’êṯ ma·ḥă·rê·šā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Instead, all the Israelites would go down to the Philistines to sharpen . . . their plowshares mattocks axes and sickles
verses.literalPt: Por isso todo o Israel tinha que descer aos filisteus para amolar cada um a sua relha, e a sua enxada, e o seu machado, e o seu sacho.

verses.original: וְֽהָיְתָ֞ה הַפְּצִ֣ירָה פִ֗ים לַמַּֽחֲרֵשֹׁת֙ וְלָ֣אֵתִ֔ים וְלִשְׁלֹ֥שׁ קִלְּשׁ֖וֹן וּלְהַקַּרְדֻּמִּ֑ים וּלְהַצִּ֖יב הַדָּרְבָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh hap·pə·ṣî·rāh p̄îm lam·ma·ḥă·rê·šōṯ wə·lā·’ê·ṯîm wə·liš·lōš qil·lə·šō·wn ū·lə·haq·qar·dum·mîm ū·lə·haṣ·ṣîḇ had·dā·rə·ḇān
verses.literal: The charge was a pim for sharpening a plowshare or mattock a third of a shekel for sharpening a pitchfork or an axe and a third of a shekel for repointing an oxgoad
verses.literalPt: Tinham porém limas para os seus sachos, e para as suas enxadas, e para as forquilhas de três dentes, e para os machados, e para consertar as aguilhadas.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בְּי֣וֹם מִלְחֶ֔מֶת וְלֹ֨א נִמְצָ֜א חֶ֤רֶב וַחֲנִית֙ בְּיַ֣ד כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶת־ שָׁא֖וּל וְאֶת־ יוֹנָתָ֑ן וַתִּמָּצֵ֣א לְשָׁא֔וּל וּלְיוֹנָתָ֖ן בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·yō·wm mil·ḥe·meṯ wə·lō nim·ṣā ḥe·reḇ wa·ḥă·nîṯ bə·yaḏ kāl- hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ’eṯ- šā·’ūl wə·’eṯ- yō·w·nā·ṯān wat·tim·mā·ṣê lə·šā·’ūl ū·lə·yō·w·nā·ṯān bə·nōw
verses.literal: So on the day of battle not a sword or spear could be found in the hands of the troops with Saul . . . and Jonathan . . . only Saul and his son Jonathan had weapons
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, no dia da peleja, não se achou nem espada nem lança na mão de todo o povo que estava com Saul e com Jônatas; porém acharam-se com Saul e com Jônatas seu filho.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ מַצַּ֣ב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אֶֽל־ מַעֲבַ֖ר מִכְמָֽשׂ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê maṣ·ṣaḇ pə·liš·tîm ’el- ma·‘ă·ḇar miḵ·māś
verses.literal: And a garrison of the Philistines . . . had gone out to the pass at Michmash
verses.literalPt: E saiu a guarnição dos filisteus ao desfiladeiro de Micmás.
